title: GFP-mCherry-LC3B Flux Analysis by FACS
author: Devin M. Fuller
materials: Prepare reagents for transfection with either lipofectamine 3000 or dharmafect.
Data analysis was performed using the FlowJo software.

steps.title: Seed cells in 6-well plate
steps.instruction: Seed 50,000 WT or GFP‑mCherry‑LC3B KI H4 cells into each well of a 6‑well treated tissue‑culture plate and maintain in DMEM supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 1× penicillin‑streptomycin.

steps.title: Grow cells to confluence
steps.instruction: Incubate for 1 day until cells reach approximately 60–70 % confluence.

steps.title: Determine need for transfection
steps.instruction: If cells do not require transfection, skip to autophagy induction (step 9).

steps.title: Wash cells before transfection
steps.instruction: Wash cells with DMEM containing 10 % FBS (no antibiotics) while cells are at 60–70 % confluence.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid transfection mix
steps.instruction: For each well, combine 1 µg target DNA, 125 µL Opti‑MEM low‑serum medium, and 2 µL P3000 reagent; separately mix 125 µL Opti‑MEM with 2 µL Lipofectamine 3000. Combine the two solutions and incubate 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare siRNA transfection mix
steps.instruction: For each well, prepare a final siRNA concentration of 25 nM by mixing the indicated siRNA with 125 µL Opti‑MEM low‑serum medium; separately mix 125 µL Opti‑MEM with 4 µL Dharmafect (Horizon Discovery). Combine the two solutions and incubate 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add transfection mixture to cells
steps.instruction: After the 10‑minute incubation, dispense 250 µL of the combined transfection mixture into each well.

steps.title: Incubate transfected cells
steps.instruction: Return plates to the incubator and incubate for 1–3 days (minimum 2 days for siRNA knock‑down) before proceeding.

steps.title: Induce autophagy with EBSS
steps.instruction: Replace the culture medium with Earle’s Balanced Salt Solution (EBSS) to start the experiment.

steps.title: Detach cells with trypsin
steps.instruction: Remove media and add 200 µL of 0.05 % trypsin to each well; incubate 3 min.

steps.title: Neutralize trypsin and collect cells
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL DMEM to each well, transfer the suspension to 15 mL conical tubes, and centrifuge at 500 × g for 2 min (temperature as indicated).

steps.title: Resuspend cells in FACS buffer
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet thoroughly in FACS buffer (1× PBS supplemented with 1× FBS) by pipetting up and down at least five times, then transfer to a round‑bottom tube fitted with a cell strainer to obtain single‑cell suspensions.

steps.title: Submit samples for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Send the prepared samples to a core facility for FACS analysis. Include a non‑labeled WT sample as a negative control and an untreated or siControl sample as a positive control, which should display a high red‑to‑green fluorescence ratio.
